brief_summary: The purpose of this clinical research study is to learn whether Saxagliptin can improve the body's ability to make its own insulin and lower blood sugar in people with type 2 diabetes
brief_title: A Study Assessing Saxagliptin Treatment in Subjects With Type 2 Diabetes Who Are Not Controlled With Diet and Exercise

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Type 2 diabetes mellitus
* Drug naive
* Hemoglobin A1c (HbA1c) ≥6.0% and ≤8.0%
* Fasting C-peptide ≥1.0 ng/mL
* Body mass index ≤40 kg/m²

Exclusion Criteria:

* Recent cardiac or cerebrovascular event
* Elevated serum creatinine

official_title: Mechanism of Action and Efficacy of Saxagliptin (BMS-477118) in the Treatment of Type 2 Diabetic Patients

primary_outcomes.measure: Insulin Secretion Rate Area Under the Curve (AUC) During Intravenous (IV)-Oral Hyperglycemic Clamp - Percent Change From Baseline at Week 12

sites.facility: Diabetes & Glandular Disease Research Assoc,, Inc.
